description:
Create a dedicated warm benchmark that records model-limit transaction costs for both journal root shapes and records the fsync-residual decision without changing production code.

## Background

The model-limit profile package stresses file count, aggregate bytes, path length, and directory shape. The harness exercises warm profile-pack and add round trips at `MAX_PROFILE_PACKAGE_FILES` for existing-root and absent-root transactions, then preserves reproducible JSON evidence.

The artifact is append-only measurement evidence: each run appends a dated record, and the initial record carries the fsync-residual decision; downstream consumers read records without rewriting them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Creates `scripts/benchmark-transaction.sh` to measure warm pack and add round trips at `MAX_PROFILE_PACKAGE_FILES` for both existing-root and absent-root journal shapes.
- [hard] REQ-02: Creates `dev/benchmarks/test-suite-performance-4b7c06d0.json` with integer-millisecond results, method, fixture shape, cache state, and a recorded fsync-residual decision.
- [hard] REQ-03: Makes the recorded decision reproducible by rerunning the benchmark and does not modify production code in this measurement task.

## Notes

The benchmark artifact is later touched by `fsync-dedupe` in an ordered overlap: that dependent task applies or records the benchmark decision after this measurement task lands.
title: Measure transaction model-limit round trips
